title: make_reference
description:
Preprocess and build a transcriptome reference.

Example input files are:
  - `genome_fasta`: https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/Gencode_human/release_41/GRCh38.primary_assembly.genome.fa.gz
  - `transcriptome_gtf`: https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/Gencode_human/release_41/gencode.v41.annotation.gtf.gz
  - `ercc`: https://assets.thermofisher.com/TFS-Assets/LSG/manuals/ERCC92.zip

dataset input.title: Dataset input
dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

genome_fasta.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `['genome_fasta.fa.gz']`

transcriptome_gtf.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `['transcriptome.gtf.gz']`

subset_regex.description: Will subset the reference chromosomes using the given regex.

output_fasta.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `['genome_sequence.fa.gz']`

output_gtf.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `['transcriptome_annotation.gtf.gz']`

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
